text:
TCP::rto
Returns the last setting to which the retransmit timer was set in
milliseconds. It does not include time elapsed since the timer was
set.
Syntax
TCP
::
rto
TCP::rto
Return Value
Retransmit timer value in milliseconds.
Examples
when
CLIENT_CLOSED
{
set
rto
[
TCP
::
rto
]
log
local0.
"Final RTO value is $rto"
}
